name: Pension Mitterer
beschreibung:
Overview

Haus Mitterer (also operated as Pension Mitterer) is located at Dorfbichl 17 in the centre of Söll am Wilden Kaiser. The Mitterer family runs the house as a private room and apartment establishment. Guests stay in two spacious apartments – “Wilder Kaiser” at around 61 m² and “Hohe Salve” at around 65 m² – as well as in a double room of about 17 m². No meals are offered; at the Hotel Feichter, around 90 m away, the breakfast buffet can be used after prior telephone reservation. Amenities include, among others, Wi-Fi, a lift, parking, a ski storage room, a drying room, a guest fridge, bicycle parking and a non-smoking lounge. The house holds the environmental quality seal, is a non-smoking house, pets are not allowed, and Grander water flows from the taps.

The location is central yet quiet: Söll village centre is around 200–300 m away, the Ahornsee around 700–800 m, and the valley station of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area around 1.3 km. The ski bus stop is about 300 m away.

History/Background

The house is run by the Mitterer family; Hans Peter Mitterer is named as the host. According to its own description, the house holds the environmental quality seal and relies on Grander water. The apartments and the lounge are modern and bright. No further verifiable information on the founding or history of the establishment is available.

Getting there

Coming from the direction of Kufstein, follow the B173 towards St. Johann and, after about 10 km, the B178 towards Söll. At the new roundabout (Salvenstadl) turn right into the village and drive around 100 m past the Postwirt and Feldwebel inns towards Hotel Feichter. At the sharp left-hand bend turn right and continue straight for about 50 m; the house is immediately on the left. Check-in is possible from 12:00, check-out until 10:00 – by arrangement also at other times. Parking is available at the house. The bus stop is around 1.1 km away and the ski bus stop around 300 m.

Tips

For breakfast, prior telephone registration at the nearby Hotel Feichter is recommended. In Söll, the Hexenwasser (approx. 1.3 km) and the Ahornsee (approx. 700–800 m) invite you on excursions. Those arriving without a car can use the nearby bus stop and ski bus stop. As it is a non-smoking house and pets are not allowed, this should be taken into account when planning.

Best time to travel

Söll am Wilden Kaiser is a destination in both winter and summer. In the winter months, the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area with its lift around 1.3 km away is within reach, while in summer the surrounding hiking trails, the Ahornsee and the Hexenwasser are ideal. No more precise season information for the house itself is documented.
